record.context_brief: Elementary equivalence classes of matrix ultraproducts
record.original_question: Let U range over non-principal ultrafilters on N. For each such U, let M_U = ∏_{n→U} M_n(C) be the tracial matrix ultraproduct and let 𝓜_U be the corresponding C*-norm matrix ultraproduct. Classify the elementary-equivalence classes of the II_1 factors M_U, and also classify the elementary-equivalence classes of the C*-algebras 𝓜_U.

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Classify elementary equivalence classes of MU where U ranges over ultrafilters on N. What about elementary equivalence classes of MU?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each non-principal ultrafilter $\mathcal U$ on $\mathbb N$, let
\[
M_{\mathcal U} \;=\; \prod_{n\to\mathcal U} M_n(\mathbb C)
\]
denote the tracial ultraproduct of the sequence of complex matrix algebras $M_n(\mathbb C)$ (each equipped with its normalized trace $\mathrm{tr}_n$); that is, $M_{\mathcal U}$ is the quotient of $\ell^\infty(\mathbb N, M_n(\mathbb C))$ by the two-sided ideal of sequences $(x_n)$ with $\lim_{n\to\mathcal U}\mathrm{tr}_n(x_n^* x_n)=0$. The algebra $M_{\mathcal U}$ is a II$_1$ factor with trace $\tau((x_n)) = \lim_{n\to\mathcal U}\mathrm{tr}_n(x_n)$.

Let
\[
\mathcal M_{\mathcal U} \;=\; \prod_{n\to\mathcal U}{}^{C^*} M_n(\mathbb C)
\]
denote the corresponding $C^*$-norm ultraproduct, i.e. the quotient of $\ell^\infty(\mathbb N, M_n(\mathbb C))$ (with $\sup$-of-operator-norms) by the ideal of sequences $(x_n)$ with $\lim_{n\to\mathcal U}\|x_n\|=0$. Then $\mathcal M_{\mathcal U}$ is a unital $C^*$-algebra.

Two II$_1$ factors (resp. two $C^*$-algebras) are called elementarily equivalent if they satisfy the same first-order sentences in the continuous logic appropriate for tracial von Neumann algebras (resp. for $C^*$-algebras).

(a) Classify, up to elementary equivalence, the II$_1$ factors $M_{\mathcal U}$ as $\mathcal U$ ranges over the non-principal ultrafilters on $\mathbb N$.

(b) Classify, up to elementary equivalence, the $C^*$-algebras $\mathcal M_{\mathcal U}$ as $\mathcal U$ ranges over the non-principal ultrafilters on $\mathbb N$.
artifact.status_search_result: The classification of elementary equivalence classes of matrix ultraproducts $M_{\mathcal U}$ and of the $C^*$-norm ultraproducts $\mathcal M_{\mathcal U}$ is a recognized open problem in the continuous model theory of operator algebras. Farah–Hart–Sherman initiated this study and showed that the Continuum Hypothesis implies all $M_{\mathcal U}$ are isomorphic (hence elementarily equivalent), while under $\neg$CH there exist II$_1$ factors with non-isomorphic ultrapowers; however, a full classification of theories of $M_{\mathcal U}$ has not been obtained. No published source claims a complete classification.

status_evidence.title: Model theory of operator algebras III: elementary equivalence and II1 factors
status_evidence.snippet: Continuous model theory of II_1 factors initiated; elementary equivalence corresponds to isomorphic ultrapowers.
status_evidence.claim: The framework for elementary equivalence of II_1 factors is established, but classification of M_U remains open.

status_evidence.title: II1 factors with non-isomorphic ultrapowers
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of II_1 factors with non-isomorphic ultrapowers under non-CH.
status_evidence.claim: Distinct elementary equivalence classes exist among II_1 ultrapowers, but no full classification of the matrix ultraproducts M_U is known.

status_evidence.title: Elementary equivalence and disintegration of tracial von Neumann algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Pseudocompact II_1 factors (those elementarily equivalent to a matrix ultraproduct) are studied; classification not given.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies pseudocompact II_1 factors but does not classify elementary equivalence classes of M_U.
